_comment: Canonical doc-type vocabulary per court level (levels are data/index.json .courts[].level). A doc-type id is the folder name under a court folder. core = every court of that level should have it (priority high); extended = common filings worth adding next (priority normal). min_pages = a folder whose longest samples/OUTPUT-*.pdf is shorter than this is a 'deepen' unit. Doc types already on disk that are not listed here stay valid; they are never reported as missing. tools/worklist.sh reads this file. Change it by PR; ids are lowercase-hyphenated.

complaint.title: Complaint
complaint.what: Initial pleading starting a civil action: caption, parties, jurisdiction and venue, numbered allegations, claims for relief, prayer, jury demand, signature.

answer.title: Answer
answer.what: Responsive pleading with admissions and denials by paragraph, affirmative defenses, counterclaims, signature, certificate of service.

motion-brief.title: Motion and supporting memorandum
motion-brief.what: Motion with memorandum of points and authorities (facts, argument headings, conclusion, certificates) as the court's local rules require.

opposition-brief.title: Memorandum in opposition to a motion
opposition-brief.what: Response to a motion, with any statement-of-disputed-facts section the court requires.

reply-memorandum.title: Reply memorandum in support of a motion
reply-memorandum.what: Movant's reply to an opposition, within the court's page limit.

notice-of-removal.title: Notice of removal
notice-of-removal.what: 28 U.S.C. 1446 notice removing a state action: grounds, venue, index of attached pleadings, certificate of notice.

notice-of-appeal.title: Notice of appeal
notice-of-appeal.what: FRAP 3 or state-equivalent notice of appeal from a final judgment or order.

declaration.title: Declaration in support
declaration.what: Sworn declaration under 28 U.S.C. 1746 (or state equivalent): numbered paragraphs, perjury attestation.

proposed-order.title: Proposed order
proposed-order.what: Proposed order submitted with a motion, in the form the local rules require.

opening-brief.title: Opening brief (appellant's principal brief)
opening-brief.what: Cover, tables, jurisdiction, issues, statement of the case, standard of review, argument, certificates, addendum as required.

answering-brief.title: Answering brief (appellee's principal brief)
answering-brief.what: Appellee's principal brief with the court's required sections and length limits.

reply-brief.title: Reply brief
reply-brief.what: Appellant's reply brief, within the court's reduced length limit.

amicus-brief.title: Amicus curiae brief
amicus-brief.what: Interest statement, authorship and funding disclosure, argument, certificates.

petition-for-rehearing.title: Petition for panel rehearing or rehearing en banc
petition-for-rehearing.what: FRAP 40 / 35 petition with the court's required statement and page limit.

petition-for-review.title: Petition for review (agency order or state high court)
petition-for-review.what: Petition seeking review of an agency order or intermediate appellate decision, with questions presented and appendix.

cert-petition.title: Petition for a writ of certiorari
cert-petition.what: S. Ct. R. 14 petition: questions presented, parties list, tables, opinions below, jurisdiction, reasons for granting.

brief-in-opposition.title: Brief in opposition to certiorari
brief-in-opposition.what: S. Ct. R. 15 brief in opposition.

merits-brief.title: Merits brief
merits-brief.what: Brief on the merits after certiorari or in an original action.

motion-for-leave.title: Motion for leave to file
motion-for-leave.what: Short motion for leave (amicus brief, oversized brief, supplemental authority).

adversary-complaint.title: Adversary proceeding complaint
adversary-complaint.what: Fed. R. Bankr. P. 7001 complaint with the local caption.

answer-to-adversary-complaint.title: Answer to adversary complaint
answer-to-adversary-complaint.what: Responsive pleading in an adversary proceeding.

motion-for-relief-from-stay.title: Motion for relief from the automatic stay
motion-for-relief-from-stay.what: 11 U.S.C. 362(d) motion with the local-form required facts.

objection-to-claim.title: Objection to proof of claim
objection-to-claim.what: Fed. R. Bankr. P. 3007 objection with the required notice language.

chapter-13-plan.title: Chapter 13 plan
chapter-13-plan.what: Local-form Chapter 13 plan, or the national form with local additions.

petition.title: Petition (original or agency proceeding)
petition.what: Petition initiating an original or agency proceeding.

trial-brief.title: Trial brief
trial-brief.what: Pretrial or trial brief required by an agency tribunal or trial court.

demurrer.title: Demurrer or state motion to dismiss
demurrer.what: State-court challenge to a pleading in the state's required format (pleading paper where mandated).

petition-for-writ.title: Petition for writ (mandate, prohibition, habeas)
petition-for-writ.what: Original writ petition with verification, memorandum and exhibit index per the rules.

brief-on-the-merits.title: Brief on the merits (state supreme court)
brief-on-the-merits.what: Principal merits brief after review is granted.

petition-for-discretionary-review.title: Petition for discretionary review
petition-for-discretionary-review.what: Petition seeking discretionary review of an intermediate-court decision.
